description: Erection of a front entrance porch.
decision_conditions: D1(a) permission to use the dwellinghouse as a dwellinghouse has not been granted only by virtue of Class M, N, P, PA or Q of Part 3 of this Schedule (changes of use);
D1(b) the ground area (measured externally) of the structure would not exceed 3 square metres
D1(c) no part of the structure would be more than 3 metres above ground level
D1(d) no part of the structure would be within 2 metres of any boundary of the curtilage of the dwellinghouse with a highway
D1(e) the dwellinghouse has not been built under Part 20 of this Schedule (construction of new dwellinghouses).

Planning permission is not required by virtue of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (Amendment) (England) Order 2015, Schedule 2, Part 1, Class D as the proposed development does not exceed the dimensions or infringe any of the other criteria set out in Class D.
